//: Hand-authored column descriptions, keyed by the exact CMS column label. These ALWAYS win and are never overwritten by scripts/build-dictionaries.mjs. Use for columns whose label diverges from the PDF (e.g. 'Facility Name' vs PDF 'CMS Provider Name') or providers whose PDFs don't auto-parse. Add an entry, run `npm run build:dictionaries`, commit.
Chain Owned: Whether Or Not The Facility Is Owned Or Managed By A Chain Organization
Chain Organization: The Name Of The Chain Organization If Applicable
Late Shift: Whether Or Not The Facility Has A Shift Starting At 5:00 P.M. Or Later
# of Dialysis Stations: The Total Number Of Dialysis Stations At The Dialysis Facility
Offers in-center hemodialysis: Whether The Facility Offers In-Center Hemodialysis
Offers peritoneal dialysis: Whether The Facility Offers Peritoneal Dialysis
Offers home hemodialysis training: Whether The Facility Offers Home Hemodialysis Training
Certification Date: The Initial Or Recertification Date For The Facility. Facilities Are Certified If They Pass Inspection; Medicare Or Medicaid Only Covers Care Provided By Certified Providers. Being Certified Is Not The Same As Being Accredited
